title: Memes & clips
description: Recognizable internet, film and animation clips for internal adult prototype testing.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 巧克力？！
quotes: 巧克力？你说的是巧克力吗？
Yes, sir. With or without nuts?
是的，先生。要有坚果的，还是没有坚果的？

scenes.title: 调成 Wumbo！
quotes: You know what the problem is?
You got it set to M for mini, when it should be set to W for Wumbo.
你把它设成了代表迷你的 M，而它应该设成代表 Wumbo 的 W。
Patrick, I don't think Wumbo is a real word.
派大星，我觉得 Wumbo 不是一个真正的词。
Come on! You know, I Wumbo, you Wumbo. He, she, me, Wumbo.
别这样！你知道的，我 Wumbo，你 Wumbo，他、她、我，Wumbo。（这是剧中的虚构词。）

scenes.title: 怪物就像洋葱
quotes: No! Layers! Onions have layers. Ogres have layers. Onions have layers.
不！层次！洋葱有层次，怪物也有层次。
You get it? We both have layers.
你明白了吗？我们都有层次。

scenes.title: 一直游下去！
scenes.english: Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming.
quotes: When life gets you down, you know what you gotta do?
当生活让你沮丧时，你知道该怎么办吗？
I don't wanna know what you gotta do.
我不想知道你要怎么办。
Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming. Just keep swimming, swimming, swimming, swimming.
一直游下去。一直游下去。游啊，游啊，游啊。
What do we do? We swim, swim.
我们要做什么？我们游啊，游啊。

scenes.title: 鱼儿是朋友！
quotes: I must first change myself. Fish are friends, not food.
我必须先改变自己。鱼儿是朋友，不是食物。
Dolphins! Yeah, they think they're so cute.
海豚！对，它们觉得自己可爱极了。

scenes.title: 飞向宇宙！
quotes: I tell you, I could fly around this room with my eyes closed.
告诉你，我闭着眼睛都能绕着房间飞。
Okay, then, Mr. Lightyear. Prove it.
那好吧，光年先生。证明给我看。
All right, then I will. Stand back, everyone.
好，我来证明。大家往后站。

scenes.title: 你是个玩具！
quotes: You are a toy! You aren't the real Buzz Lightyear! You're an action figure! You are a child's plaything!
你是个玩具！你不是真正的巴斯光年！你是一个人偶，是孩子的玩具！
You are a sad, strange little man, and you have my pity. Farewell.
你是一个可怜又奇怪的小家伙，我同情你。告辞。
Oh, yeah? Well, good riddance, you loony!
哦，是吗？走了正好，你这个疯子！

scenes.title: 有风格地落下！
quotes: This isn't flying. This is falling with style.
这不叫飞，这叫有风格地落下。
We're not aiming for the truck.

scenes.title: 我就是速度！
quotes: One hundred seventy-five miles per hour!
每小时一百七十五英里！
Okay! You did it, buddy! You can back off now!
好！你做到了，伙计！你现在可以慢下来了！

scenes.title: 咔嚓！
quotes: Hey, fellas, how do you think I'd look in Dinoco blue?
嘿，伙计们，你们觉得我涂上恐龙石油的蓝色会怎么样？
Yeah, right. Thunder? What's he talking about, thunder?
是啊，才怪。雷声？他为什么说雷声？
You know, because thunder always comes after lightning! Ka-chow!
你知道的，因为雷声总在闪电之后！咔嚓！

scenes.title: 太毛茸茸了！
quotes: I saw that with my own eyes!
Let me explain something to you. You see how it's not knocked over?
让我给你解释一下。看见了吗？它没有倒下。

scenes.title: 那地板呢？
quotes: Rule number one: you will not touch anything.
Yes, you may touch the floor.
Yes, you may touch the air.

scenes.title: 松鼠！
quotes: My master made me this collar. He is a good and smart master, and he made me this collar so that I may talk.
我的主人给我做了这个项圈。他是个善良又聪明的主人，这个项圈能让我说话。
My master is good and smart.
Oh, it is because my master is smart.
哦，这有可能，因为我的主人很聪明。

scenes.title: 刚认识就喜欢你！
scenes.english: I have just met you, and I love you.
quotes: Did that dog just say hi there?
那只狗刚才说了“你们好”吗？
Oh, yes! My name is Dug. I have just met you, and I love you.
哦，是的！我叫道格。我刚认识你，就已经喜欢你了。

scenes.title: 谁都能做饭！
quotes: How do you know? What do I always say? Anyone can cook.
你怎么知道？我常说什么？谁都能做饭。
Well, yeah, anyone can. That doesn't mean that anyone should.
嗯，对，谁都能做。可这不代表谁都应该做。
Well, that is not stopping him. See?
可这并没有让他停下来。看。

scenes.title: 没有秘密配料！
quotes: Come here. The secret ingredient is nothing.
过来。秘密配料就是——什么都没有。
You heard me. Nothing. There is no secret ingredient.
你没听错。什么都没有。没有什么秘密配料。
Wait, wait. It's just plain old noodle soup? You don't add some kind of special sauce or something?
等等，就是普通的面汤？你没有加什么特别的酱料之类的吗？
Don't have to. To make something special, you just have to believe it's special.
不需要。要让一样东西变得特别，只需要相信它是特别的。

scenes.title: 我没有不开心！
quotes: I understand. You eat when you are upset.
我理解。你不开心的时候就会吃东西。
Upset? I'm not upset. What makes you think I'm upset?
不开心？我没有不开心。你为什么觉得我不开心？

scenes.title: 吼一声嘛！
quotes: Excuse me, Mr. Shrek. Could you do that ogre roar of yours for my son? He's a big, big fan.
打扰了，史莱克先生。可以为我儿子表演一下怪物吼叫吗？他是你的超级粉丝。
You know, I'd rather not. It's my kids' birthday party.
我还是不想。这是我孩子们的生日聚会。
Honey, why don't you go check on the cake?
亲爱的，你去看看蛋糕好吗？
Sure. And don't forget the candles.

scenes.title: 谁让你们来这里的？
quotes: Oh, gosh, no one invited us.
We were forced to come here.
He huffed and he puffed and he—
他呼哧呼哧地吹气，然后他——

scenes.title: 我准备好了！
scenes.english: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!
quotes: 我准备好了！我准备好了！
No! I'm ready to pass my boating test!
不是！我准备好通过驾驶考试了！

scenes.title: 蛋黄酱是乐器吗？
quotes: How many of you have played musical instruments before?
你们有多少人以前演奏过乐器？
No, Patrick, mayonnaise is not an instrument.
不是，派大星，蛋黄酱不是乐器。
Horseradish is not an instrument either.

scenes.title: 微笑，挥挥手！
scenes.english: Just smile and wave, boys. Smile and wave.
quotes: Just smile and wave, boys. Smile and wave.
小伙子们，微笑，挥挥手。微笑，挥挥手。
We're only five hundred feet from the main sewer line.
距离主下水道只剩五百英尺了。
我们的最后一把铲子也断了。
Right. Rico, you're on litter patrol. We need shovels, and find more Popsicle sticks. You don't want to risk another cave-in.
好。瑞哥，你去找废弃物。我们需要铲子，再找些冰棒棍。你可不想再冒塌方的风险。
I want you to look cute and cuddly, Private.
你的任务是保持可爱，菜鸟。

scenes.title: 我看起来怎么样？
quotes: Oh no! The magic hat has turned Ben blue!
哦，不！魔法帽把本变蓝了！
Um, I think your old hat suits you better.
嗯，我觉得你原来的帽子更适合你。
阿布拉卡佐波迪！（剧中的魔法咒语）
Ah, it's good to have my old hat back again.
啊，能重新戴上我的旧帽子真好。
And it's nice to have you back, wand. I will never lose you again.
魔法棒，你也回来了，真好。我再也不会把你弄丢了。

scenes.title: 精灵从来不害怕！
quotes: I'm an elf. Elves are never scared.
我是精灵。精灵从来不害怕。
Er, good. In that case, can I try again?
呃，那就好。那我可以再试一次吗？

scenes.title: 我可以和本一起玩吗？
quotes: But Nanny Plum, I was going to play with Ben.
可是梅姨，我本来打算和本一起玩。
Princess Holly, there's a time for playing with elves and a time for wand practice.
霍莉公主，和精灵玩有玩的时间，练习魔法棒有练习的时间。
Please, Nanny. I promise to practise later.
求你了，梅姨。我保证待会儿练习。
Hmm, very well, but come in when I—
嗯，好吧，不过等我叫你时就——

scenes.title: 你一直坐在眼镜上！
quotes: Daddy Pig, you were sitting on them all the time!
猪爸爸，你一直坐在眼镜上！
I don't know how they got there.
我不知道眼镜怎么跑到那里了。

scenes.title: 猜猜我们干什么了！
scenes.english: Guess what we have been doing!
quotes: Daddy, Daddy! Guess what we've been doing!
爸爸，爸爸！猜猜我们干什么了！
Let me think. Have you been watching television?
让我想想。你们在看电视吗？
Have you just had a bath?
I know! You've been jumping in muddy puddles!
我知道了！你们在泥坑里跳来跳去！
Yes, yes, Daddy! We've been jumping in muddy puddles!
对，对，爸爸！我们在泥坑里跳来跳去！

scenes.title: 我们帮你找眼镜好吗？
scenes.english: Can we help find your glasses?
quotes: Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
一定有人把我的眼镜放到什么地方了。
Do you remember where you last put them, Daddy Pig?
猪爸爸，你记得上次把眼镜放在哪里了吗？
When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket. But they aren't there now.
不戴的时候，我总把眼镜放在口袋里。可是现在不在里面。
Daddy, can we help find your glasses?
爸爸，我们帮你找眼镜好吗？
Good idea, Peppa. If you find them, Daddy will stop being so grumpy.
好主意，佩奇。找到眼镜，爸爸就不会这么暴躁了。

scenes.title: 病人可以有访客吗？
scenes.english: Can the patient have a visitor?
quotes: Oh no! What's wrong with George?
Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game.
别担心，爸爸。我们只是在玩游戏。
Oh, I see. Can the patient have a visitor?
哦，我明白了。病人可以有访客吗？
Just for a little while. He might get tired.
只能一小会儿。他可能会累的。
Yes, they're for George. They're his medicine to make him feel better.
对，给乔治的。这是让他好起来的药。

scenes.title: 能给我们几个真硬币吗？
scenes.english: Can we have some real coins?
quotes: This machine doesn't take imaginary coins. Go and get a job and earn real ones.
这台机器不收想象出来的硬币。去干点活，挣几个真的吧。
Mum, can we have some real coins?
妈妈，能给我们几个真硬币吗？
I said go and get a job.
Well, if you kids make Mum and Dad's bed, I'll give you twenty cents.
好吧，你们把爸爸妈妈的床铺好，我就给你们二十分钱。
我盯着你呢，魔法抓娃娃机。

scenes.title: 爸爸，这不公平！
quotes: I am not Dad. I am Magic Claw. Magic Claw has no children. His days are free and easy.
我不是爸爸，我是魔法抓娃娃机。魔法抓娃娃机没有孩子，每天都自由自在。

scenes.title: 煎饼飞得太高啦！
quotes: The secret of making a good pancake is to flip it high into the air.
做出好煎饼的秘诀，就是把它高高地翻到空中。
Oh, maybe that was just a bit too high.
哦，可能刚才翻得有点太高了。
Oh, what a shame. That was the last pancake.
哦，真可惜，那是最后一张煎饼了。
It should be a simple matter to get it down.
把它弄下来应该很简单。

scenes.title: 再给乔治一次机会
quotes: George found me! Now it's Daddy's turn to hide.
乔治找到我啦！现在轮到爸爸藏起来了。
Oh, I think George should have another turn.
哦，我觉得应该让乔治再来一次。
But George isn't very good at hiding.
I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
我相信这次他会藏得更好。闭上眼睛，开始数数吧。

scenes.title: 我的魔法出了一点错
scenes.english: My magic went a bit wrong
quotes: Er, it's Ben. I accidentally turned him into a hat.
呃，那是本。我不小心把他变成帽子了。
Princess Holly, that's exactly why you need to practise your magic more.
霍莉公主，这正是你需要多练习魔法的原因。
I was practising, but it all went a bit wrong.
我刚才就在练习，可是出了一点错。

scenes.title: 我有一个简单的计划
scenes.english: I have got a simple plan
quotes: But Ben, how are you going to find my wand?
可是，本，你要怎么找到我的魔法棒呢？
First, try to remember where you left your wand. In your bedroom, perhaps.
首先，想想你把魔法棒放在哪里了。也许在你的卧室里？
Or in the meadow. That's where I left it.
或者在草地上。我就是把它落在那里了。
What's the next bit of your plan?
你的计划下一步是什么呢？

scenes.title: 你认识松饼人吗？
scenes.english: Do you know the Muffin Man?
quotes: Okay, I'll tell you. Do you know the Muffin Man?
好吧，我告诉你。你认识松饼人吗？
Yes, I know the Muffin Man. Who lives on Drury Lane?
我认识松饼人。住在德鲁里巷的那个？
Well, she's married to the Muffin Man.
She's married to the Muffin Man.

scenes.title: 倒着开车的高手
quotes: That driving backwards stuff. It's creeping me out. You're gonna wreck or something.
就是倒着开车这事。看得我心里发毛。你会撞车的。
Wreck? Shoot, I'm the world's best backwards driver. Just watch this right here, lover boy.
撞车？我可是世界上最会倒着开车的。看好了，情圣。
What are you doing? Watch out! Watch out!

scenes.title: 这是开心果冰淇淋吗？
quotes: Hey, what you got here that's free? How about that pistachio ice cream?
这里有什么免费的？那个开心果冰淇淋怎么样？
Oh, same old, same old. What's up with you? That looks delicious.
哦，老样子。你怎么样？看起来真好吃。
A little more, please. It is free, right? Keep it coming. A little more. Come on, let's go. It's free! You're getting there. There you go. Now that's a scoop of ice cream.
请再多一点。是免费的吧？继续加。再来一点。来吧，免费的！快够了。对了，这才叫一勺冰淇淋。

scenes.title: 你看见闪电麦昆了吗？
quotes: I'd like to introduce you to Lightning McQueen.
我来介绍一下闪电麦昆。
Mr. Sterling, did you say Lightning McQueen was here? Because I don't see him anywhere.
史特林先生，你说闪电麦昆来了？我怎么没看见？
Uh, but he's right here. Do you not see him?
他就在这儿。你没看见吗？
He's right in front of you. It's Lightning McQueen.
他就在你面前，是闪电麦昆。
He's obviously an impostor. He looks old and broken down, with flabby tires.
他显然是冒牌货。他看起来又老又破，轮胎也松垮垮的。

scenes.title: 我的鳍上有标签？
scenes.english: There is a tag on my fin?
quotes: All you have to do is give me the tag.
你只要把标签给我就行。
What tag? There's a tag on my fin?
什么标签？我的鳍上有标签？
How could you forget? You have a tag on your fin.
你怎么会忘了？你的鳍上有标签。
Oh, no, I'm sorry. I suffer from short-term memory loss.
You don't remember what we were talking about?
你不记得我们在聊什么了？

scenes.title: 找到你的出口伙伴
quotes: All right, we're here, dudes. Get ready. Your exit's coming up, man.
伙计们，我们到了。准备好，你们的出口快到了。
I see it! I see it!
You mean the swirling vortex of terror?
你说的是那个可怕的漩涡？
Okay, first find your exit buddy. Do you have your exit buddy?
先找到你的出口伙伴。找到了吗？

scenes.title: 换一种方言试试
quotes: Dory, Dory, this is not whale. You're speaking like upset stomach.
多莉，这不是鲸鱼语。听起来像肚子疼。
也许我该试试座头鲸语。
No, don't try humpback. All right, you actually sound sick.
别试座头鲸语。你听起来真的像生病了。
Too much orca, didn't it? It sounded a little orca-ish.
太像虎鲸了，是吧？有点虎鲸的感觉。
It doesn't sound orca. It sounds like nothing I've ever heard.
一点也不像虎鲸。我从没听过这种声音。

scenes.title: 奈斯比特太太
quotes: Buzz? Hey! Buzz, are you okay?
Gone. It's all gone. All of it's gone. Bye-bye. See ya.
One minute you're defending the whole galaxy, and suddenly you find yourself sucking down Darjeeling with Marie Antoinette and her little sister.
刚才还在保卫整个银河，转眼却在陪玛丽王后和她妹妹喝茶。
I think you've had enough tea for today. Let's get you out of here, Buzz.
你今天茶喝够了。我们走吧，巴斯。
Don't you get it? You see the hat? I am Mrs. Nesbitt!
你还不明白吗？看见这顶帽子了吗？我是奈斯比特太太！

scenes.title: 我有激光
quotes: You're in direct violation of code six four zero four point five, stating all Space Rangers are to be in hypersleep until awakened by authorized personnel.
你违反了条例6404.5：所有太空骑警必须休眠，直到获授权人员唤醒。
You're breaking ranks, Ranger. Buzz Lightyear to Star Command. I've got an AWOL Space Ranger.
你擅离岗位了，骑警。巴斯光年呼叫星际总部，有太空骑警逃离岗位。
Tell me I wasn't this delusional.
我以前没有这么糊涂吧。
No back talk. I have a laser, and I will use it.
不许顶嘴。我有激光，而且我会使用它。
You mean the laser that's a light bulb?
你说的是那个小灯泡激光？

scenes.title: 求求你啦
quotes: Will you read us a bedtime story?
你能给我们讲睡前故事吗？
The physical appearance of the please makes no difference. It is still no, so go to sleep.
求我的样子再好看也没有用。还是不行，睡觉去。
But we can't. We're all hyper. And without a bedtime story, we'll just keep getting up and bugging you.
我们睡不着，都太兴奋了。不讲故事，我们就会不停起床烦你。

scenes.title: 抱住你的腿啦
quotes: Hi, I'm Margo. This is Edith. That's Agnes.
你好，我叫玛戈。这是伊迪丝，那是艾格尼丝。
I got your leg! I got your leg!
Okay, that's enough, little girl. Let go of my leg. Come on, little girl. Just release your grip. Wow. How do you remove them? Is there a command? Some nonstick spray? Crowbar?
好了，小姑娘，够了。松开我的腿。松手吧。要怎么把她弄下来？有口令吗？防粘喷雾？撬棍？

scenes.title: 特工露西
quotes: Hi. Agent Lucy Wilde of the AVL. Oh, whoops. Sorry. You're gonna have to come with me.
你好，我是反恶人联盟的露西特工。哎呀，抱歉，你得跟我走一趟。
Oh, you know, you really should announce your weapons after you fire them, Mr. Gru. For example.
格鲁先生，你应该先发射武器，再报武器名字。比如这样。
Lipstick taser! Oh, it works so good.

scenes.title: 我能帮你过点什么吗？
scenes.english: Can I help you cross something?
quotes: Good afternoon. My name is Russell, and I am a Wilderness Explorer in Tribe fifty-four, Sweat Lodge twelve. Are you in need of any assistance today, sir?
下午好，我叫罗素，是54部落12分队的荒野探险家。先生，您需要帮助吗？
I could help you cross the street.
I could help you cross your yard.
I could help you cross your porch.
Well, I gotta help you cross something.

scenes.title: 你听过沙锥鸟吗？
scenes.english: Have you heard of a snipe?
quotes: You want to assist an old person?
Yep! Then I'll be a Senior Wilderness Explorer.
对！这样我就能成为高级荒野探险家了。
You ever heard of a snipe?
Bird. Beady eyes. Every night it sneaks in my yard and gobbles my poor azaleas. I'm elderly and infirm. I can't catch it. If only someone could help me.
一种小眼睛的鸟。每晚偷偷跑进院子吃我的杜鹃花。我年老体弱，抓不到它。要是有人能帮我就好了。
Oh, I don't know. It's awfully crafty. You'd have to clap your hands three times to lure it in.
这可不好说，它很狡猾。你得拍三下手才能引它出来。
我会找到它的，弗雷德里克森先生！
I think its burrow is two blocks down. If you go...
它的窝好像在两个街区外。你往……

scenes.title: 它们喜欢巧克力吗？
quotes: Do they have a lot of colors?

scenes.title: 你在吃那个？
quotes: You don't know, and you're eating it?
You know, if you can sort of muscle your way past the gag reflex, all kinds of food possibilities open up.
只要设法忍过想吐的感觉，各种食物都能接受了。

scenes.title: 餐厅又火了
quotes: What is it, Ambrister? Gusteau's finally closing, is it?
怎么了？古斯托餐厅终于要关门了吗？
It's announced a new line of microwave egg rolls?

scenes.title: 梦见面条
quotes: What were you doing up there? All that noise.
你在楼上干什么？那么吵。
Oh, nothing. Just had a crazy dream.
没什么，就是做了个奇怪的梦。
About what? Huh? What were you dreaming about?
What was I... I was dreaming about... noodles.
Noodles? You were really dreaming about noodles?
面条？你真的梦见了面条？
Yeah. What else would I be dreaming about?
对啊，不然还能梦见什么？
Oh, careful! That soup is sharp. Oh, happy day! My son finally having the noodle dream!
小心，这汤烫。真是好日子！我儿子终于梦见面条了！

scenes.title: 你可以吃了
quotes: Just like that? No sit-ups? No, no, no, no, no ten-mile hike?
就这样？不用做仰卧起坐，也不用走十英里？
I vowed to train you, and you have been trained. You are free to eat. Enjoy.
我答应训练你，现在你已经完成训练。可以吃了，请享用。
I said you are free to eat. Have a dumpling.
我说你可以吃了。来个包子。

scenes.title: 什么的内心平静？
quotes: Wow. Awesome. How did you do that?
哇，太厉害了。你怎么做到的？
Inner peace? That's cool. Inner peace of what?
内心平静？真酷。什么的内心平静？
It is the next phase of your training. Every master must find his path to inner peace.
这是你下一阶段的训练。每位大师都要找到通往内心平静的道路。

scenes.title: 你许了什么愿？
quotes: Come on, what'd you wish for?
No siree, I'm telling you, it's bad luck. You want some bad luck? I'll blab it out. But if you want to be safe, I'll keep...
不行，说出来会倒霉的。你想倒霉的话，我就说。要想平安的话……
Would you just tell us? I mean, really, what could happen?
告诉我们吧，到底能发生什么？
Okay. I wished I could go to the wild.
Whoa. I told you it was bad luck.

scenes.title: 纽约巨人
quotes: You must tell me, who the heck are you?
快告诉我，你们究竟是谁？
I'm Alex. The Alex. And this is Gloria, Marty, Melman.
我是艾力狮。这是格洛丽亚、马蒂和梅尔曼。
Just where are you giants from?
你们这些巨人从哪里来？
All hail the New York Giants!

scenes.title: 这盏灯是什么意思？
quotes: It looks like a small incandescent bulb designed to indicate something out of the ordinary, like a malfunction.
看起来是个小灯泡，用来指示异常情况，比如故障。
I find it pretty and somewhat hypnotic.
我觉得它挺漂亮，还有点催眠。
好，瑞哥，手册。问题解决了。
Sir, we may be out of fuel.
We've lost engine one. And engine two is no longer on fire.
一号发动机停了，二号发动机也不冒火了。

scenes.title: 出了点小状况
quotes: No, no, no. You don't talk now, okay? You're not so good with the putting the words together and they're coming out good thing. You keep it shh.
别说了。你不太擅长组织语言，你先安静一下。

Hey, how you doing? Yeah, you know what? Everything's cool. We just had a little situation here. Little internal situation. Actually, my friend just went a little crazy. Happens to everybody. The city gets to us all. Just went a little cuckoo in the head.
你们好，一切正常。我们只是出了点小状况，内部小状况。我朋友有点失控，这种事谁都会遇到。这座城市让大家都有压力，他只是脑子有点糊涂。
Hey, don't be calling me cuckoo in the head!

scenes.title: 慢慢尝尝味道
quotes: Close your eyes. Now take a bite of this. No, no. Don't just hork it down!
闭上眼睛，咬一口。别一口吞下去！
Here. Chew it slowly. Only think about the taste. See? Creamy, salty, sweet, an oaky nuttiness. You detect that?
给你，慢慢嚼。只想着它的味道。尝到了吗？奶油味、咸味、甜味和橡木果仁香。感觉到了吗？
嗯，我确实感觉到果仁味了。
Close your eyes. Now taste this. A whole different thing, right? Sweet, crisp, slight tang on the finish.
闭上眼睛，尝尝这个。完全不一样吧？香甜清脆，回味有一丝酸味。

scenes.title: 来一点见解
quotes: Do you know what you would like this evening, sir?
先生，今晚您想点些什么？
Yes, I think I do. After reading a lot of overheated puffery about your new cook, you know what I'm craving? A little perspective. That's it.
我想好了。读了那么多对你们新厨师夸大的吹捧后，你知道我渴望什么吗？一点见解。
I'd like some fresh, clear, well-seasoned perspective. Can you suggest a good wine to go with that?
没错。我想要新鲜、清楚、调味得当的见解。能推荐一款搭配的葡萄酒吗？
Perspective. Fresh out, I take it?

scenes.title: 祝你有玉米般美好的一天！
quotes: I hope you really have a corntastic day!
祝你们有玉米般美好的一天！这里把 corn 和 fantastic 合成一个双关词。
What? It's just a pun about corn!
怎么了？这只是一个关于玉米的双关语！

scenes.title: 显然，你会晕！
quotes: Tell me about the ride. What did you think about the ride?
说说这个游乐项目吧，你觉得怎么样？
Because apparently you're spinning around, and apparently every time you get dizzy.
因为显然你会转来转去，而且显然每次都会晕。
That's all you do is get dizzy.

scenes.title: 精神伤害！
quotes: Steven, when you get so fat?
史蒂文，你什么时候变得这么胖了？这是一句不礼貌的讽刺台词。
You probably could just hold down the block button.
你也许只要一直按住格挡键就行了。

scenes.title: 你也想知道吧，天气男孩？
scenes.english: Wouldn't you like to know, weather boy?
quotes: Here's an actual customer out here.
这里有一位真正的顾客。
What's the best kind of firework to buy?
Wouldn't you like to know, weather boy?
你也想知道吧，天气男孩？这是一句故意调侃的回答。
Kid's sketchy. Back to you guys.
这孩子有点可疑。交回演播室。

scenes.title: 我喜欢乌龟！
quotes: Back here live at the Waterfront Village with my friend, the zombie, Jonathon.
这里是滨水村的直播现场，我身边是僵尸朋友乔纳森。
You're looking good. Jonathon just got an awesome face paint job. What do you think?
你看起来不错。乔纳森刚画了很棒的脸部彩绘，你觉得怎么样？
All right. You're a great zombie.
好吧。你是个很棒的僵尸。

scenes.title: 九加十等于多少？
quotes: 你真笨。这是原片中的不礼貌说法。
二十一。这是搞笑的错误答案；正确答案是十九。
你真笨。保留原始玩笑台词。
